summary: Backend changes show new server-side sanitization for signup role and profile update role, plus a new profile-existence gate for getCallerUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile, and deleteUser now attempts to revoke AccessControl role by assigning #guest. However, due to truncation of backend/main.mo, there is no visible evidence that the same profile-existence gate, createdBy sanitization, and report-id uniqueness protections were implemented for the report endpoints (createReport/listReports/getReportById).

missing_requirements.requirement: Require that the caller has an existing user profile to use createReport, listReports, and getReportById, trapping with an English signup-required message if missing.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows verifyUserHasProfile being called in getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile, but the sections containing createReport/listReports/getReportById are not shown in the truncated backend/main.mo diff, so there is no evidence these endpoints were updated.

missing_requirements.requirement: During createReport, ignore any incoming report.createdBy value and always persist createdBy = caller as the only creator value stored.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff explicitly sanitizes role during signupWithCode, but no createReport implementation is visible in the truncated diff to confirm createdBy is being server-enforced and client-supplied createdBy is ignored.

missing_requirements.requirement: Prevent report overwrites by enforcing report ID uniqueness in createReport and trap with an English message if the id already exists.
missing_requirements.reason: No createReport logic is shown in the truncated diff, and there is no visible check for an existing report id prior to insertion.
